title: Flatten and Unflatten Config Dicts

visible.label: Multi-level nested config round-trip
visible.expectedDisplay: Flattens to dotted keys and reconstructs nested dict cleanly

hidden.label: Depth 4 nesting
Custom separator supported
hidden.script:
assert flatten_dict({"a": {"b": 1}}, sep="/") == {"a/b": 1}
assert unflatten_dict({"a/b": 1}, sep="/") == {"a": {"b": 1}}

hidden.label: Multiple sibling branches merge under shared parent in unflatten
Preserves list leaf values intact

hints: In flatten_dict(d, sep="."), recurse only when isinstance(value, dict) and value is non-empty.
In unflatten_dict(d, sep="."), split each compound key with key.split(sep), walk down `cur = cur.setdefault(part, {})` for intermediate segments, and assign `cur[parts[-1]] = value`.
